name: Radiant Marks cuts Sunslam's channel time by 1 sec (#2457)
contract: Radiant Marks 704947 (SpellFamilyName 33) has two live effects, both EffectSpellClassMask word 3 bit 0x1000000 (16777216), matching Sunslam's (805629) own SpellFamilyFlags_3 16777216: effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107) with EffectMiscValue 1 (SPELLMOD_DURATION) and EffectBasePoints -1001 -> real -1000 ms, matching the tooltip's 'Reduces the channel time of Sunslam by 1 sec' against Sunslam's own DurationIndex 35 = 4000 ms (4 -> 3 seconds); effect 1 is the same aura with EffectMiscValue 19 (SPELLMOD_ACTIVATION_TIME) and EffectBasePoints -351 -> real -350 ms, a bonus tick-speed clause the quoted tooltip line does not mention but that is equally native (AuraEffect::HandleAuraPeriodicMod feeds SPELLMOD_ACTIVATION_TIME into the periodic tick amplitude, and Sunslam's own EffectAmplitude_1 is 1000 ms). Both ops are read through Player::ApplySpellMod, which the 'spell_modifier' query metric calls directly, without casting Sunslam or entering its channel. Native handlers only; regression scenario for behaviour that already works.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Without the talent Sunslam keeps its own 4 second channel
Radiant Marks cuts Sunslam's channel to 3 seconds
Without the talent Sunslam keeps its own 1 second tick interval
Radiant Marks also speeds Sunslam's ticks to 650 ms
